/api/public/content.services_intro: Eight in-house services with one demo each. Watch the one you need, read what is included, then choose a quality package at the end.
/api/public/content.review_hero_desc: Honest feedback from creators, shops and brands we edit for. Every review below is read and published by our team — nothing is auto-posted.
/api/public/content.team_intro: A small studio of editors, designers and motion artists. Every project is handled by the person who will actually cut it — no account managers in between. Below is the founder and the team you will be working with.

services.name: Professional Video Editing
services.description: Creative, high-quality video editing tailored to your content and brand.
services.subtitle: Creative, high-quality video editing tailored to your content and brand.
services.long_description:
This is the core service: we take raw footage and turn it into a finished video that feels intentional from the first frame.
You get a story pass, a pacing pass, a colour grade and a sound balance — then clean exports for wherever the video is going.
services.deliverables:
Final MP4 (1080p or 4K)
Project file on request
Stills for thumbnails and socials
services.bullet_points:
Story-first edit structure
Colour correction and sound balance
Titles, captions and lower thirds
Platform-ready exports (1080p / 4K)

demo_videos.title: Product Launch Promo
demo_videos.description: Thirty-second launch promo with motion graphics and grade.

services.name: YouTube Editing
services.description: Retention-focused long-form edits that keep viewers watching till the end.
services.subtitle: Retention-focused long-form edits that keep viewers watching till the end.
services.long_description:
A YouTube edit is more than cutting clips together. We build the story first, then cut to a rhythm that survives the first 30 seconds.
Every project includes a pacing pass, caption styling, sound balance and a colour pass so the final export looks and sounds intentional on any device.
services.deliverables:
Final MP4 (1080p or 4K)
Project file on request
Thumbnail-ready stills
services.bullet_points:
Pacing pass and story structure
Captions, titles and lower thirds
Colour correction and sound balance
Platform-ready exports (1080p / 4K)

demo_videos.title: Studio Session
demo_videos.description: Full edit breakdown of a studio interview — cut, grade and sound pass.

demo_videos.title: Timeline Craft
demo_videos.description: Narrative documentary cut with a paced voice-over bed.

services.name: Shorts & Reels
services.description: Punchy vertical cuts for TikTok, Reels and Shorts — built to go viral.
services.subtitle: Punchy vertical cuts for TikTok, Reels and Shorts — built to go viral.
services.long_description:
Short-form is a different craft: the hook decides everything. We cut for retention with fast hooks, tight pacing and captions that stay readable on a phone.
Each delivery lands as a ready-to-upload vertical file with safe margins for every platform.
services.deliverables:
9:16 MP4 exports
Caption file (.srt) on request
services.bullet_points:
Hook in the first 2 seconds
Beat-matched cuts and zooms
Bold on-screen captions
9:16 exports ready to upload

demo_videos.title: Creator Short
demo_videos.description: A 15-second vertical hook built for Shorts and Reels.

services.name: Motion Graphics
services.description: Custom intros, lower thirds and animated graphics that elevate your brand.
services.subtitle: Custom intros, lower thirds and animated graphics that elevate your brand.
services.long_description:
Motion graphics should explain something in half a second. We design clean, on-brand animation that supports the edit instead of competing with it.
Delivered as ready-to-drop clips in your brand colours, type and pacing.
services.deliverables:
Rendered animation clips
Alpha-channel exports on request
services.bullet_points:
Custom vector animation
Logo reveals and transitions
Tracked callouts and stats
Brand-consistent styling

services.name: Thumbnail Design
services.description: Scroll-stopping, high-CTR thumbnails that boost your click-through rate.
services.subtitle: Scroll-stopping, high-CTR thumbnails that boost your click-through rate.
services.long_description:
A thumbnail is a tiny billboard. We design around one clear idea, keep contrast high and typography short so it still reads on a phone.
You get two variants per concept so you can test which one earns the click.
services.deliverables:
PNG + JPG at 1280×720
Editable source file
services.bullet_points:
Niche-based composition
Readable text hierarchy
Face cut-out and colour grading
Two variants per concept

services.name: Brand Videos
services.description: Promotional and corporate videos that tell your brand story with impact.
services.subtitle: Promotional and corporate videos that tell your brand story with impact.
services.long_description:
A brand film is the version of your story that people actually finish watching. We keep it short, specific and visually consistent with your identity.
The delivery includes the master film plus cutdowns sized for the platforms you actually post on.
services.bullet_points:
Narrative structure and voice-over bed
Brand colour and type treatment
Motion graphics package
Music licensing guidance

services.name: Social Media Ads
services.description: High-converting ad creatives for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Reels.
services.subtitle: High-converting ad creatives for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Reels.
services.long_description:
Paid social lives or dies on the first two seconds. We build each creative around one clear promise, then cut square, vertical and landscape versions so the same idea runs on every placement.
Every ad set ships with hook variants, so you can test what actually converts instead of guessing.
services.deliverables:
Master ad + placement exports
Hook variant cuts
services.bullet_points:
Hook variants for A/B testing
9:16, 1:1 and 16:9 versions
Burned-in captions
Safe-zone checked for each platform

services.name: Product Videos
services.description: Clean, engaging product showcases that turn viewers into customers.
services.subtitle: Clean, engaging product showcases that turn viewers into customers.
services.long_description:
A product video has one job: make the object feel worth owning. We build around clean product moments, add motion callouts for the details that matter and keep the pace short enough to finish.
Deliverables are sized for both your product page and paid placements.
services.deliverables:
Master product video (1080p / 4K)
Square and vertical cutdowns
services.bullet_points:
Product hero and detail passes
Motion callouts and labels
Clean background and grade
Cutdowns for ads and product pages

packages.description: Everyday quality — clean edits with a standard export.
